newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Blow your whistle, Filipino police told.
newsitem.headline: Blow your whistle, Filipino police told.

text.p: Don't shoot, just blow your whistle, said a southern Philippine police chief giving guidance to his men on how to dissuade a person from committing a crime.
Police should not fire warning shots if they saw someone about to commit a crime, said Davao city police commander Colonel Isidro Lapena, according to the Philippine News Agency (PNA).
"They should instead blow their whistle," PNA quoted Lapena as saying.
"People respect the sound of a whistle from a policeman."
